sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "renditions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NULL, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((content IS NULL) <> (relative_path IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "relations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "to_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" INTEGER NULL, "source_char_start" INTEGER NULL, "source_char_end" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (from_item_id, to_item_id, kind), CHECK (from_item_id <> to_item_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "highlights" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rendition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES renditions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "excerpt" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (end_offset > start_offset), CHECK (start_offset >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chunks" ("row_key" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "char_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "char_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_ms" INTEGER NULL, "end_ms" INTEGER NULL, "page_number" INTEGER NULL, "heading_path" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE (item_id, seq));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flashcards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "front" TEXT NOT NULL, "back" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'freeRecall', "ease_factor" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5, "interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "repetitions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_reviewed_at" INTEGER NULL, "source_chunk_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chunks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source_char_start" INTEGER NULL, "source_char_end" INTEGER NULL, "last_exported_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flashcard_options" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "flashcard_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flashcards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_correct" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_correct" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_chunk_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chunks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source_char_start" INTEGER NULL, "source_char_end" INTEGER NULL, "source_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notebook" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "query_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "notebook_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES notebook (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "is_user" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_user" IN (0, 1)), "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "sources_json" TEXT NULL, "attachments_json" TEXT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "property_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text', "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (name COLLATE NOCASE));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "property_values" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "number_value" REAL NULL, "date_from_year" INTEGER NULL, "date_from_month" INTEGER NULL, "date_from_day" INTEGER NULL, "date_to_year" INTEGER NULL, "date_to_month" INTEGER NULL, "date_to_day" INTEGER NULL, "date_precision" TEXT NULL, "date_is_circa" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("date_is_circa" IN (0, 1)), "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES property_values (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "depth" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("depth" BETWEEN 0 AND 4), "name_family" TEXT NULL, "name_given" TEXT NULL, "name_suffix" TEXT NULL, "is_institution" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("is_institution" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (definition_id, value COLLATE NOCASE));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_property_values" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "property_value_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_values (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "property_value_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "property_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "property_value_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_values (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (definition_id, alias COLLATE NOCASE));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_url" TEXT NULL, "author_name" TEXT NULL, "author_url" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_blob_path" TEXT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "dedup_hash" TEXT NULL, "simhash" TEXT NULL, "processing_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "processing_error" TEXT NULL, "processing_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "note_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "maturity" TEXT NOT NULL, "dedup_hash" TEXT NULL, "simhash" TEXT NULL, "generated_by_model" TEXT NULL, "generated_at" INTEGER NULL, "derived_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("derived_edited" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "embeddings" ("chunk_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chunks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "vector" BLOB NOT NULL, "model_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("chunk_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_issues" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "migration" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suggestions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merged_provenances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "author_name" TEXT NULL, "author_url" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "merged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inline_link" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (from_item_id, normalized_title));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "field_version" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "field_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "base_device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "field_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merge_conflict" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "field_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_value" TEXT NULL, "incoming_value" TEXT NULL, "other_rendition_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES renditions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "local_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "local_device_id" TEXT NULL, "incoming_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "incoming_device_id" TEXT NULL, "detected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL, "resolution" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "flashcard_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flashcards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reviewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grade" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval_before" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval_after" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ease_before" REAL NOT NULL, "ease_after" REAL NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_reference" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reference_type" TEXT NULL, "container_title" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "publisher_place" TEXT NULL, "edition" TEXT NULL, "volume" TEXT NULL, "issue" TEXT NULL, "pages" TEXT NULL, "isbn" TEXT NULL, "issn" TEXT NULL, "doi" TEXT NULL, "accessed_at" INTEGER NULL, "citation_key" TEXT NULL, "publication_precision" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_contributor" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "property_value_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_values (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "property_value_id", "role"), UNIQUE (item_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_view" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "query_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "view_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_template" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "blocks_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "properties_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notebook_item" ("notebook_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notebook (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("notebook_id", "item_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_event" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
